description: This file defines an interface 'EnforcementProvider' parameterized with a type extending Signal, which specifies methods for creating enforcement logic, checking applicability, and transforming signals into enforcement tasks within a stream processing context.

classes.name: EnforcementProvider
classes.description: A provider interface for enforcement logic applicable to signals, capable of creating enforcement strategies and integrating into streaming workflows.

methods.name: getCommandClass
methods.description: Returns the class type of commands that this enforcement applies to.

methods.name: isApplicable
methods.description: Checks if the enforcement provider is applicable to a specific command instance.

methods.name: createEnforcement
methods.description: Creates an enforcement instance based on the provided contextual information.

methods.name: changesAuthorization
methods.description: Determines if the given signal will affect authorization states.

methods.name: createEnforcementTask
methods.description: Converts the enforcement provider into a stream graph that produces enforcement tasks, optionally integrating pre-enforcement steps.

methods.name: buildEnforcementTask
methods.description: Constructs an enforcement task from a contextual signal and pre-enforcer, encapsulating enforcement logic.

methods.name: mapToHandledClass
methods.description: Maps a generic message object to an instance of the command class if applicable.
